cases.text: At sunset the observatory shutters opened. A patient astronomer adjusted the telescope while distant clouds drifted across the horizon. Several measurements disagreed, so she repeated the observations before recording her conclusion.
Rain collected beneath the greenhouse windows. The gardener carried seedlings outside and inspected their roots. Tomorrow the neighbours would bring fresh compost and repair the damaged fence.
